+package benchmark
+
+// LinearGenerator produces a sequence of benchmark configurations
+// starting at a lower bound rate, incrementing by a fixed step on each
+// call to Next, and stopping once the upper bound is exceeded.
+type LinearGenerator struct {
+	// Start is the initial requests-per-second rate (inclusive).
+	Start float64
+	// Stop is the final requests-per-second rate (inclusive when reached exactly).
+	Stop float64
+	// Step is the increment added to the current rate on each call to Next.
+	Step float64
+
+	current float64
+	done    bool
+}
+
+// NewLinearGenerator returns a LinearGenerator initialized to Start.
+// If Step <= 0 the generator is a one-shot that returns only the Start value.
+// If Start > Stop the generator is a one-shot that returns only the Start value.
+func NewLinearGenerator(start, stop, step float64) *LinearGenerator {
+	return &LinearGenerator{
+		Start:   start,
+		Stop:    stop,
+		Step:    step,
+		current: start,
+	}
+}
+
+// Next returns the next benchmark Config in the linear sweep and a bool
+// indicating whether more values remain. When the current rate exceeds Stop,
+// or when Step is non-positive, the generator signals completion after the
+// first value.
+func (g *LinearGenerator) Next() (Config, bool) {
+	if g.done || g.current > g.Stop || g.Step <= 0 && g.current != g.Start {
+		return Config{}, false
+	}
+	cfg := Config{Rate: g.current}
+	g.current += g.Step
+	return cfg, true
+}

+type GeneratorConfig struct {

@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+/*

+you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+You may obtain a copy of the License at

+See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+limitations under the License.
+*/
+
+package benchmark
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestLinearGenerator_NormalProgression(t *testing.T) {
+	gen := NewLinearGenerator(10, 30, 10)
+	cfg, ok := gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 10.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	cfg, ok = gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 20.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	cfg, ok = gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 30.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	_, ok = gen.Next()
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}
+
+func TestLinearGenerator_ExactStop(t *testing.T) {
+	gen := NewLinearGenerator(5, 5, 1)
+	cfg, ok := gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 5.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	_, ok = gen.Next()
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}
+
+func TestLinearGenerator_StartGreaterThanStop(t *testing.T) {
+	gen := NewLinearGenerator(20, 10, 5)
+	cfg, ok := gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 20.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	_, ok = gen.Next()
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}
+
+func TestLinearGenerator_ZeroStep(t *testing.T) {
+	gen := NewLinearGenerator(10, 100, 0)
+	cfg, ok := gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 10.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	_, ok = gen.Next()
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}
+
+func TestLinearGenerator_NegativeStep(t *testing.T) {
+	gen := NewLinearGenerator(50, 0, -10)
+	cfg, ok := gen.Next()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, 50.0, cfg.Rate)
+
+	_, ok = gen.Next()
+	// Negative step means one-shot.
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}
+
